publication issues.summary: Early unsealed partial V4: 22 unresolved render cells including 19 wire glyph differences, and 10 uncertainties: missing IBM division, six illegible pin identities and assumed one-character first-destination branch lengths for AD4, AB4 and BB4. Team3 reports 137 unresolved endpoint claims, 48 unlabeled contacts and six control-only records; preserve source claims without assigning electrical roles. Individual native differences, routes, points, omissions, independent registration and external schema status remain unestablished. The saved converter output predates the renderer successor; no rerun or electrical approval is asserted. Team3 reports the parent viewed native tile 1-4 only, observing BX B09-star, AB J07T and AA D04-star; no full-route conclusion follows. The block fit was untrusted (22/74), edge fit 7/39, with maximum disagreement 102.660 px; the overlay is unreliable. The other 15 native tiles, 26 junctions, 256 crossings, full routes, omissions and warp remain unassessed. Twenty-five generated route sections were not inspected; seven zero-length segments and 256 unjoined entries are leads only. The renderer changed concurrently and the precise renderer version at conversion was not recorded.
publication issues.qualification: Published for access with the recorded review limitations; no electrical correctness or user approval asserted.
